title: feat(model-monitor): restore favorites and persistent filters
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reverts #13506 and restores the final implementation from #12644.
- Re-adds per-model favorites, the Favorites-only view, favorites-first sorting, and persisted scope/type filters.
- Includes the earlier fixes that validate stored favorites and leave Favorites-only mode when the last favorite is removed.
- Changes one file; the restored blob is byte-for-byte identical to the reviewed #12644 version.

Validation:
- `npx --yes @biomejs/biome@2.3.10 check operations/model-monitor/src/App.jsx`
- `git diff --cached --check`

gist.headline: The favorites bloom again
gist.blurb: The model monitor got its little bookmarks back. Favorite models stay sorted up front, and the filters remember where you left them.
gist.summary: Restored the reviewed model-monitor implementation with per-model favorites, a Favorites-only view, favorites-first sorting, persisted scope/type filters, validation for stored favorites, and automatic exit from Favorites-only mode when its last model is removed.
gist.impact: Model-monitor users can again keep their preferred models at the top and return to the same scope and type filters between visits without getting stranded in an empty favorites view.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy model-monitor workspace where Polli organizes favorite model cards into a flowering garden, with heart-shaped bookmark markers and labeled filter knobs that remain set in place. A small CRT monitor robot happily points at a glowing Favorites shelf while persistent filter vines wrap gently around the terminal.
